acceptanceCriteria: The test's deadline is derived from observed progress or made load-tolerant without weakening the descendant-retirement assertion.
Stress evidence: the test passes repeatedly under induced load (e.g. -count=20 with parallel CPU load).
body: Found by CEM dynamic lane V1-0592 (PR beamfall/corvint#1003, head 1398a8c24, base origin/main 7c9a52d90, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/dynamic-2026-10-17/. internal/testrunner TestExecuteRetiresDetachedDescendants failed twice with TimedOut at load average 33-45 after merging main; passes alone in 6.9s. Flake under load, not caused by the lane diff.
title: TestExecuteRetiresDetachedDescendants times out under host load
